name: Chicago Zen Meditation Community
reason: too thin. zenchicago.org (read 13 Nov 2026) has only three content pages: about, one schedule page listing all its weekly sittings and study groups (a single offering URL) and a support page; its talks are only on SoundCloud, its one embedded video is from another channel (SOTOZENNET), and its photos sit on an amazonaws.com S3 bucket. Teacher Myoshi Roger Thomson is not on Spiritpedia.
